written_by: Darby, award-level creative and UX pass 2026-10-04 evening (earlier version by worker e4475a)
person_made_it: The full list of 57 dishes grouped by protein with search and filters, written like a board someone chalked by hand, not a database dump.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The same kitchen host, listing what is cooked, naming allergens only from the dish names and saying so.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Sunday afternoon, deciding next week; the search box is the first control.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes: a sticky protein bar with counts jumps to Chicken 26, Beef 7, Fish 7, Shrimp 9, Pasta 7 or Breakfast 1, and every one of the 57 rows now shows its dish as a photo instead of a bare pictogram.
works_for_the_recipient: Fina can add or strike dishes in one list; eaters find pork-free or no-shellfish in one tap.
taught_me_something: Fifty-seven dishes with no macros is a menu, not a nutrition page; honesty about missing numbers beats invented ones.
told_me_the_truth: Each photo is labeled illustrative in its alt text; allergen marks still come from dish names only and the page says so.
weakest: 57 illustrative photos raise appetite but are not Fina's food; when her plates arrive they should replace these one for one. Filters still sit above the jump bar on phone, so the bar is one scroll down.
